species.real: In the tale young John Lambton skipped church to go fishing, hooked a small ugly worm and threw it down a well. By the time he came home from the Crusades it had grown big enough to wrap itself round a hill.
species.name: Lambton Worm

dex.text: Wraps itself around hills and bridges with great enthusiasm and a great many teeth. Would much prefer to be left alone, and is rarely that lucky.
dex.fact: Legend says the Lambton family was cursed for nine generations after a knight defeated the worm, and the story is from County Durham.
